title: Cosmology as Representation: Informational Invariance and the Limits of Scientific Realism
summary: Modern cosmology is often taken to provide an increasingly accurate description of the universe's underlying ontology through progressively refined mathematical models. I challenge this interpretation by arguing that the empirical success of cosmology underdetermines not only ontology but also the mathematical and conceptual frameworks used to represent observational data. I propose instead that the objective content of cosmology is best identified with cross-representational informational invariants-features of observational structure that persist across empirically adequate descriptions.…
